name: Chili Crunch Ground Chicken Bowls
instructions: [CHILI CRUNCH CUCUMBER SALAD] Whisk 1 tbsp chili crunch, 1 tbsp coconut aminos, maple syrup, rice vinegar, ginger and salt in a bowl; toss in the diced cucumber and sliced green onions, cover and chill until serving.
Cook your rice, quinoa or cauliflower rice per the package directions.
[CHILI CRUNCH CHICKEN] Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat and brown the ground chicken, stirring often, 5 to 7 minutes until cooked through.
[CHILI CRUNCH CHICKEN] Meanwhile whisk together 1/3 cup coconut aminos, 2 tbsp chili crunch, maple syrup, rice vinegar and grated garlic.
[CHILI CRUNCH CHICKEN] Pour the sauce over the chicken and simmer gently, stirring now and then, 3 to 5 minutes until slightly thickened; stir in the lime juice and take off the heat.
Divide the grain, chicken and cucumber salad among 4 bowls; finish with sliced green onion and extra chili crunch if you like.

name: Baked Salmon With Lemon And Garlic
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400F.
Check the salmon for pin bones and remove any you find.
Stir the oil, garlic, lemon juice, paprika, salt and pepper together in a small bowl.
Coat the fillets all over with the oil mixture, making sure some garlic sits on top of each, then lay them skin side down and spaced apart in a baking dish or on a rimmed sheet pan.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes, until the salmon is cooked to your liking.
Scatter parsley and dill over the top and serve with lemon wedges.

name: Greek Chicken Meatballs With Tzatziki
instructions: [DAIRY-FREE TZATZIKI SAUCE] Blend the mayonnaise, diced cucumber, lemon juice, garlic, mint, dill, salt and pepper in a small food processor until smooth; adjust seasoning and refrigerate in a sealed container.
[GREEK SALAD] Toss the halved tomatoes, cucumber, olives, red onion and salt in a large bowl with 2 tbsp vinaigrette; set aside.
[GREEK CHICKEN MEATBALLS] Mix the ground chicken, almond flour, egg, mint, salt, oregano, basil, dill, garlic powder, onion powder and pepper thoroughly in a large bowl.
[GREEK CHICKEN MEATBALLS] Scoop about 1.5 tbsp portions, roll into balls and set on a plate until all the mixture is used.
[GREEK CHICKEN MEATBALLS] Heat the olive oil in a large cast iron skillet over medium-high heat and sear the meatballs on all sides, about 3 minutes.
[GREEK CHICKEN MEATBALLS] Lower the heat and keep cooking 10 to 15 minutes until the centers reach 165F.
[GREEK CHICKEN MEATBALLS] Move the cooked meatballs to a bowl, pour over 1/3 cup vinaigrette and toss to coat.
Plate the Greek salad with the meatballs and drizzle with tzatziki; or serve over rice with feta, in pita, or alongside lemon orzo.

name: Instant Pot Chicken Sweet Potato Curry
instructions: Set the Instant Pot to saute, add the oil, onion and garlic, and cook until the onion turns translucent.
Add the chicken, sweet potato, bell pepper, broth, curry powder, cumin, turmeric, cayenne and salt.
Seal the lid and cook on high pressure for 10 minutes (it takes roughly 10 more minutes to come to pressure).
Quick-release the pressure, remove the lid and switch back to saute.
Stir in the coconut milk and frozen green beans and cook 2 to 3 minutes until the beans are hot; adjust curry powder and salt to taste.
Serve over cauliflower rice, rice or greens, topped with cashews, cilantro and lime wedges.

name: One-Pan Tuscan Chicken And Rice
instructions: Pour the oil from the sun-dried tomato jar into a lidded container (keep the tomatoes), add the chicken with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, chili powder, basil, oregano and red pepper flakes, and rub to coat.
Mix in the minced shallot and garlic, arrange the chicken on top, cover and marinate in the fridge at least 30 minutes or overnight.
Heat the olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat, lift the chicken out (leaving the shallot and garlic behind) and cook about 5 minutes per side until nearly done, 155 to 160F; set aside.
Add the shallot, garlic and any leftover oil from the container to the pan and cook 2 to 3 minutes, stirring; add the rice and toast 1 to 2 minutes.
Stir in the mushrooms and sun-dried tomatoes and cook 2 to 3 minutes more.
Pour in the broth, coconut milk and lemon juice, salt to taste, add the spinach and bring to a simmer.
Reduce to medium-low, lay the chicken on top, cover and cook 15 to 20 minutes, stirring once halfway, until the rice is fluffy and the chicken reads 165F.
Divide among 4 plates and top with chopped basil.

name: Salmon With Creamy Spinach Risotto
instructions: Combine the basil, oregano, salt, pepper and chili powder; pat the salmon dry and coat the tops and sides with the spice mix.
Heat the olive oil in a deep lidded skillet over medium heat, add the salmon skin side up and cook 4 minutes; flip and cook 4 to 7 minutes more until it reaches 145F, then set aside.

In the same skillet cook the shallot and garlic 1 to 2 minutes until translucent, add the rice and toast 1 minute, then stir in the cauliflower rice and cook about 4 minutes until thawed; season with salt and pepper.

Add the broth, coconut milk and lemon juice, bring to a simmer, cover and cook 10 to 13 minutes until the liquid is nearly absorbed, stirring once or twice (drop to medium-low on a gas stove; add a splash of broth if needed).
Stir in the spinach until wilted, remove from the heat and return the salmon to the top of the risotto.
Garnish with chopped basil and divide among 4 plates.

name: Vegetable Lentil Soup
instructions: Warm the olive oil in a soup pot over medium heat and cook the onion, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes until deeply golden.
Push the onion aside, add the tomato paste to the cleared spot and stir 2 to 3 minutes until it darkens to a rusty brown.
Add the thyme, garlic, celery and carrots and cook 2 minutes.
Add the lentils, 8 cups water, soy sauce, salt and pepper; keep at a gentle simmer over medium heat for 55 to 60 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Puree 2 cups of the soup in a blender (or pulse briefly with an immersion blender) and stir it back in for body, then add the lemon juice.
Stir in the kale and simmer 1 to 2 minutes until softened; season with more salt, pepper or lemon juice and serve with crusty bread or a salad.

name: Easy Lentil Patties
instructions: Put everything except the flour in a food processor and blend until very smooth, scraping down the sides as needed.
Pulse in the flour just until combined.
Portion the mixture with a 1 tbsp measuring spoon, roll into balls and flatten into patties (add a little more flour if sticky, a splash of water if dry).
Heat olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat and cook the patties 4 minutes per side, pressing gently after flipping; serve warm with dips.
Oven option: bake on a parchment-lined pan at 375F for 20 to 22 minutes until lightly browned.
Air fryer option: cook at 375F for 10 to 12 minutes, spritzing the tops with olive oil for extra browning.
